notes.title: Update coming
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

There is a pretty big update sheduled for the end of this week, more on that in the release notes. Here are some things you can expect:

[list]
[*]Achievements
[*]Explicit headset improvements (Vive, Rift)
[*]Full screen mirrored view on monitor (great for recording gameplay)
[*]General fixes and improvements
[*]NVIDIA SLI support
[*]NVIDIA Pascal full VR feature set support
[/list]

and more...

Thank you for support, 
Cheers!


Nejc L.



UPDATE: 14.10.2016

Update will be a few days late, because we're waiting for the new Pascal hardware to arrive, BUT, there is a beta version available right now!

You can download beta version for a preview, features may still be missing and/or may be unstable, It's available under "publicbeta". Right click on the game in your library, select properties, click on tab "BETAS" and select "publicbeta..." from a drop down box, there is no password.

notes.title: Vive patch available
notes.content:
Dear players,

a user notified me about Vive controllers problems and with a bit of back and forward I've been able to pin them down. I sincerely apologize to any Vive users that encountered these problems; not being able to navigate main menus with controllers touchpad/d-pad + trigger to confirm. They are now patched and an update is already available for download. Thank you!

Nejc L.

notes.title: ShowdownVR controls
notes.content:
Here are key bindings for the game, also found under Options / Controls.

[h1] To navigate the menu, use the same key bindings as those for steering the ship, usually trackpad / D-pad.[/h1] 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303649/828ece230be8b42e8ea0f06141cf373e01027f7a.jpg[/img]

For more please see: showdownvr.com
